scope: Ten verified pre-registered paper sources. Exact registered URLs were readable; no new external sources.

verified_claims: NOVA reports that retrieval noise worsens LLM confidence calibration and conflicting or irrelevant evidence increases overconfidence on four benchmarks.
The paper reports ECE improvements from NOVA Rules and approximately 2K HotpotQA supervised examples in its stated settings.
records.boundary: Research benchmarks and model/training settings do not establish production calibration or universal gains.

verified_claims: The paper uses multilingual PTLM fill-mask with a Value Intermediate Representation for temporal-expression normalization.
It reports a two-stage English biomedical pretraining and cross-language/domain adaptation setup outperforming prior systems in its experiments.
records.boundary: The languages, domains, corpora and model settings are specific; results do not guarantee performance for arbitrary Chinese business data.

verified_claims: ConflictRAG detects, classifies and resolves inter-source conflicts before generation using a two-stage detector with selective LLM use.
The registered URL currently presents v2 while the registry records v1; reported metrics are from the paper's three benchmark experiments.
records.boundary: Preprint experiments, thresholds, trust weighting and reported gains are not production guarantees and the registry/page version difference must remain explicit.

verified_claims: Q-CaRE provides query-agnostic reference-free RAG evaluation by decomposing queries into subqueries and answers into atomic claims.
It defines coverage-aware C-Prec and C-nDCG metrics plus completeness, conciseness and verifiableness measures, evaluated on eight human-annotated datasets.
records.boundary: Decomposers, alignment judges, datasets and models are paper conditions; this does not replace target-domain human calibration.

verified_claims: The benchmark contains 983 expert-validated samples across six domains and combines retrieval noise, knowledge gaps, factual conflicts and complex instruction constraints.
Its reported experiments show a gap between single-constraint and full multi-constraint adherence under the stated 13-model evaluation.
records.boundary: This preprint's benchmark and framework were not yet released as reproducible assets; reported figures are not a production SLA.

verified_claims: ATBench evaluates agent safety at trajectory level using risk-source, failure-mode and real-world-harm dimensions with heterogeneous tools and delayed long-context triggers.
The benchmark combines rule/LLM filtering with full human audit and supports intermediate-action diagnosis in its stated 1,000-trajectory setting.
records.boundary: The preprint benchmark distribution and model rankings do not directly generalize to enterprise agents.

verified_claims: OpenRAG-Soc evaluates indirect prompt injection in social-web RAG across ingestion, retrieval and generation, including HTML/Markdown cleaning, Unicode normalization and attribution-gated answering.
It reports attack success, sparse/dense rank shift, utility and latency under its stated corpus and system configurations.
records.boundary: The social-web corpus and attack distribution are specific; defenses require retesting on the target collector, parser and models.

verified_claims: UniDoc-Bench evaluates document-centric multimodal RAG on real cross-domain PDFs by linking text, table and figure evidence.
Its unified candidate-pool protocol compares text-only, image-only, text-image fusion and joint retrieval paradigms in the reported experiments.
records.boundary: Dataset, language, parser and model conditions require remeasurement; reported fusion results are not universally optimal.

verified_claims: The paper shows that modifying only image-text metadata can manipulate multimodal retrieval and induce generation despite unchanged visual content.
Its experiments cover four retrievers and two generators and report defenses that often fail against metadata-only poisoning in the tested setting.
records.boundary: Attack rates and defense outcomes are specific to the preprint's attack, retrievers, generators and benchmark.

verified_claims: Dense X Retrieval defines a proposition as a single, concise, self-contained natural-language fact unit and compares document, passage, sentence and proposition retrieval granularity.
Its experiments report finer-grained proposition retrieval gains under the stated tasks and fixed compute budget.
records.boundary: The data, language, models and budget are paper conditions; propositions are not universally optimal and must preserve source spans.
